cloud.beta.notLetIn: This account isn't in the beta yet
cloud.install.agents.missing: Not on this machine yet:{missing}. The station runs agents with them; install one to get started:
cloud.install.agents.signIn: Once installed, sign in under Settings → Profile in still.fail.
cloud.install.drain: Waiting for running agent turns to end before restarting (up to 10 min; new messages queue until then)…
cloud.install.handoff.failed: Couldn't hand over ({why}); restarting the station instead.
cloud.install.handoff.keptOld: Not handed over ({why}): the new release is not used; the station runs on the one before.
cloud.install.handoff.noAnswer: Station didn't answer the handover; restarting instead.
cloud.install.handoff.start: Handing over to the new version (agents keep running)…
cloud.install.inside: Update started inside the station (an agent turn or job): it restarts in the background once running turns, this one included, end.
cloud.install.installed: still.fail station is installed and running in the background; it'll appear in the workspace in a few seconds.
cloud.install.move.linked: Couldn't move {old} to {data}; {data} now points to it instead.
cloud.install.move.moved: Moved data from {old} to {data} (a link is left at the old place).
cloud.install.move.noLink: Data moved to {data}, but couldn't leave a link at {old}.
cloud.install.node.broken: Node {version} does not run on this machine; it was not installed.
cloud.install.node.download: Downloading Node {version} for the station (once per version)…
cloud.install.node.failed: Could not download Node {version} from {origin}; run the install command again once the network is back.
cloud.install.node.mismatch: The downloaded Node {version} did not match its checksum and was not installed; run the install command again.
cloud.install.unsupported: Only macOS (Apple silicon), Linux (x64, arm64) and Windows (x64) are supported for now; this is {machine}.
cloud.install.upToDate: still.fail station is already up to date ({version}); nothing to update.
cloud.install.updateNoToken: A station already in a workspace needs no token to update: stillfail update
cloud.install.updated: still.fail station is updated; running agents weren't interrupted.
cloud.install.usage: Usage: curl -fsSL {origin}/install.sh | sh -s -- <token> (get the token from Add station in still.fail)
cloud.install.where.app: Program: {app} (the stillfail command is in ~/.local/bin; its old name, ember, still works)
cloud.install.where.linger: To keep it running when no one is logged in, run: sudo loginctl enable-linger {user}
cloud.install.where.noService: No systemd user services here: the station runs in the background now but won't start after a reboot; run stillfail start then.
cloud.install.where.status: Status: stillfail status (which workspace, whether it's online, why it isn't working)
cloud.install.win.noGit: On Windows the station runs jobs and commands with Git Bash (Claude Code needs it there too), which this machine doesn't have yet: install Git for Windows (https://git-scm.com/download/win).
cloud.install.win.pathAdded: Added {dir} to your PATH: stillfail works in terminals opened from now on.
cloud.install.win.stopping: Stopping the running station to put the new version in place (interrupted turns go on once it starts again)…
cloud.install.win.cmdPath: The stillfail command cannot name this path: {path} (it has non-ASCII characters and is outside your user folders). Set STILLFAIL_DATA to a directory with ASCII only and try again.
cloud.install.win.task: Starts at Windows sign-in: scheduled task "{task}"
cloud.install.win.taskFailed: Couldn't register the scheduled task that starts the station at sign-in ({why}); it runs now, but after signing in again run stillfail start.
cloud.install.win.usage: Usage: & ([scriptblock]::Create((irm {origin}/install.ps1))) <token> (in PowerShell; get the token from Add station in still.fail)
cloud.install.where.wslKeep: This is WSL on Windows: with no WSL window open, Windows stops it and the station with it. To keep it running, have Windows run this when you sign in: wsl.exe -d {distro} --exec sleep infinity
cloud.install.where.wslKept: Windows starts WSL ({distro}) in the background when you sign in and keeps it running, so the station stays online (stillfail-station-{distro}.vbs in your Startup folder; delete it to stop that).
cloud.install.where.wslSystemd: This is WSL on Windows without systemd: the station runs in the background now but stops whenever WSL does. To keep it running, add the two lines [boot] and systemd=true to /etc/wsl.conf (with sudo), run wsl --shutdown in Windows PowerShell, then open WSL and run this install command again.
cloud.login.complete.body: The result shows where you started signing in. You can close this page.
cloud.login.complete.title: Go back to still.fail
cloud.login.device.reach: Once signed in, it can reach stations in your workspaces.
cloud.login.device.title: Allow device to connect remotely
cloud.login.ended.body: Go back to still.fail and sign in again.
cloud.login.ended.title: Sign-in request ended
cloud.preview.gone: Preview disconnected: reopen it in still.fail.
cloud.preview.host: This is a still.fail preview address: open a preview in still.fail.
